admission.justification: Omitting a kit colour lets the host silently derive replacement fills and text, recreating the embedded chat regression on a host update.

applicability: The Agents Remember dark theme registered with the Paseo plugin kit for embedded chat.
conditions: The client registers the complete colour object with addTheme.
The kit type is required in the plugin type check.
exclusions: Standalone host themes and user colour settings.
The Architect's separate post-release visual observation.

evidence: The Worker report's Clean-copy checks record npm run typecheck on the full declaration and TS1360 with surface3 removed in the scratch mutation.

statement: The Agents Remember theme states every colour in the Paseo plugin kit's theme contract, including the six fills and faint-text values that the host can otherwise derive.
